In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that

the path-integral for D-branes of the A-type in string theory is given by a sum over the genus-like expansion of morphisms from a family of Azumaya spaces to a complex manifold, with a fundamental module.

the Polchinski- Grothendieck picture of D-branes in string compactifications is realized by special Lagrangian A-branes in the sense of Donaldson, which in turn can be described as special Lagrangians with a unitary connection in the sense of Joyce, with a fundamental module in the sense of the author, which can be deformed and re-assembled under an attractor flow, as in Joyce’s work.
the Polchinski- Grothendieck picture of D-branes in string compactification is a special case of the Polchinski-Hitchin picture.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that

we have given a prototypical definition for supersymmetric D-brane of A-type in a region of Wilson’s theory-space, and that this definition is in agreement with the Polchinski’s Ansatz for D3-branes and the Denef’s picture of D-branes in Calabi-Yau manifolds.
